sites.name: NCBI ORF Finder
sites.description: 在官方页面复核六阅读框、起始密码子与开放阅读框。
sites.descriptionEn: Review six reading frames, start codons and open reading frames on the official page.

sites.name: NCBI BLASTn
sites.description: 将核酸序列与所选核酸数据库比对。
sites.descriptionEn: Align a nucleotide sequence against a chosen nucleotide database.

sites.name: NCBI BLASTp
sites.description: 查找蛋白同源序列并检查覆盖度与一致性。
sites.descriptionEn: Find protein homologs and inspect coverage and identity.

sites.name: NCBI PSI-BLAST
sites.description: 通过迭代搜索寻找普通 BLASTp 难以发现的远缘同源。
sites.descriptionEn: Iterative search for distant homologs ordinary BLASTp may miss.

sites.name: InterPro
sites.description: 整合蛋白家族、结构域、保守位点与 GO 注释。
sites.descriptionEn: Integrated protein families, domains, conserved sites and GO annotations.

sites.name: NCBI CDD / CD-Search
sites.description: 以保守结构域数据库复核蛋白域与功能位点。
sites.descriptionEn: Review protein domains and functional sites against the conserved domain database.

sites.name: ScanProsite
sites.description: 扫描 PROSITE 模式与 profile，定位保守基序。
sites.descriptionEn: Scan PROSITE patterns and profiles to locate conserved motifs.

sites.name: PSIPRED Workbench
sites.description: 预测蛋白二级结构并提供官方结果页面。
sites.descriptionEn: Predict protein secondary structure with an official result page.

sites.name: JPred4
sites.description: 独立预测蛋白二级结构，适合与其他方法交叉复核。
sites.descriptionEn: Independent secondary structure prediction for cross-checking.

sites.name: Phobius
sites.description: 联合预测跨膜拓扑与信号肽。
sites.descriptionEn: Joint transmembrane topology and signal peptide prediction.

sites.name: SignalP 6.0
sites.description: 预测信号肽类型与切割位点。
sites.descriptionEn: Predict signal peptide type and cleavage site.

sites.name: TMHMM 2.0
sites.description: 复核跨膜螺旋与蛋白拓扑。
sites.descriptionEn: Review transmembrane helices and protein topology.

sites.name: DeepTMHMM
sites.description: 以深度学习模型预测跨膜拓扑与蛋白类别。
sites.descriptionEn: Deep-learning transmembrane topology and protein class prediction.

sites.name: Plant-mPLoc
sites.description: 面向植物蛋白预测亚细胞定位。
sites.descriptionEn: Predict subcellular localization for plant proteins.
sites.automationNote: 固定定位 FASTA 文本框与提交按钮；等待 CGI 结果标志后打开最终结果页。

sites.name: Cell-PLoc 2.0
sites.description: 按所选生物类别复核蛋白亚细胞定位。
sites.descriptionEn: Review protein subcellular localization by organism class.

sites.name: DeepLoc 2.1
sites.description: 预测亚细胞定位、膜关联及排序信号。
sites.descriptionEn: Predict subcellular localization, membrane association and sorting signals.

sites.name: MusiteDeep
sites.description: 预测磷酸化、泛素化、甲基化等翻译后修饰位点。
sites.descriptionEn: Predict phosphorylation, ubiquitination, methylation and other PTM sites.

sites.name: STRING
sites.description: 检索蛋白关联网络并核对物种映射。
sites.descriptionEn: Retrieve protein association networks and verify species mapping.

sites.name: UniProtKB / BLAST
sites.description: 用蛋白序列检索 UniProtKB，并进入人工审阅的条目。
sites.descriptionEn: Search UniProtKB by protein sequence and reach curated entries.

sites.name: eggNOG-mapper
sites.description: 执行正交群、GO、COG 与功能注释。
sites.descriptionEn: Orthologous groups, GO, COG and functional annotation.

sites.name: IUPred3
sites.description: 预测蛋白内在无序区域。
sites.descriptionEn: Predict intrinsically disordered regions.

sites.name: HMMER phmmer
sites.description: 以 HMMER 补充蛋白同源搜索。
sites.descriptionEn: Complement protein homology search with HMMER.

sites.name: MAFFT Web
sites.description: 在网页中执行多序列比对，作为本地工具之外的人工选项。
sites.descriptionEn: Web-based multiple sequence alignment as a manual alternative to local tools.

sites.name: iTOL
sites.description: 上传 Newick 与注释数据包，交互式排版系统发育树。
sites.descriptionEn: Upload Newick and annotation packages for interactive tree styling.

sites.name: ESPript 3
sites.description: 将多序列比对排版为结构感知的出版图。
sites.descriptionEn: Render structure-aware publication figures from an alignment.

sites.name: AlphaFold DB
sites.description: 按 UniProt accession 检索公开预测结构。
sites.descriptionEn: Look up public predicted structures by UniProt accession.

sites.name: SWISS-MODEL
sites.description: 在交互页面选择模板并进行同源建模。
sites.descriptionEn: Choose templates and run homology modeling interactively.

sites.name: PrankWeb
sites.description: 上传结构并预测潜在配体结合口袋。
sites.descriptionEn: Upload a structure and predict ligand binding pockets.
